replies.author: Gundham
replies.body:
Greetings, BabyBumWipes.

Seeing as you've spent a considerable amount of time banned, haven't attempted to evade your ban, and it looks like you've learned your lesson, I'll be appealing your punishment.

If you're caught hacking once again, you won't be able to appeal anymore. Make sure to keep up to date with the rules, too.

Happy holidays, and welcome back to the server!

Sincerely,
Vinnx - Senior Moderator
